description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dewamottawa, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511223 (23/1052)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and owner details) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters. The content falls under the Land Gazette classification as it involves official registration of land titles and ownership determinations.
